record.paper_title: Open problems in Gaussian fluid queueing theory
record.context_brief: Relaxation metrics and busy period tail
record.original_question: For the same Gaussian fluid queue, let D_1(t)=sup_{u>0} γ(u,t) and D_2(t)=∫_0^∞ γ(u,t) du, where γ(u,t)=P(Q>u)−P(Q^tr(t)>u). Let K be the ongoing busy period at time 0, defined by K=inf{s≥0:Q(s)=0}−sup{s≤0:Q(s)=0}. Determine the exact asymptotics as t→∞ of D_1(t), D_2(t), and P(K>t).

evidence.quote: D1(t) := sup u>0 γ(u,t), and D2(t) := ∫∞ 0 γ(u,t) du were studied for queues driven by fractional Brownian motion.
K := inf{s ≥ 0 : Q(s) = 0} − sup{s ≤ 0 : Q(s) = 0} denotes the ongoing busy period at time 0.
Open Problem 3.2 Find the exact asymptotics of metrics D1(t),D2(t), as well as those of P(K > t), as t → ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\{X(t)\}_{t\in\mathbb{R}}$ be a centered Gaussian process with stationary increments, $X(0)=0$, and continuous sample paths, and let $c>0$ be a constant drift such that the net input process $X(t)-ct$ has negative drift. Define the stationary Gaussian fluid queue workload
$$Q(t)=\sup_{s\le t}\bigl(X(t)-X(s)-c(t-s)\bigr),\qquad t\in\mathbb{R},$$
and the corresponding transient workload starting empty at time $0$,
$$Q^{tr}(t)=\sup_{0\le s\le t}\bigl(X(t)-X(s)-c(t-s)\bigr),\qquad t\ge 0.$$
Assume the stationary distribution of $Q$ exists. For $u>0$ and $t\ge 0$ set
$$\gamma(u,t)=\mathbb{P}(Q>u)-\mathbb{P}(Q^{tr}(t)>u),$$
and define the relaxation-to-stationarity metrics
$$D_1(t)=\sup_{u>0}\gamma(u,t),\qquad D_2(t)=\int_0^\infty \gamma(u,t)\,du.$$
Let
$$K=\inf\{s\ge 0:Q(s)=0\}-\sup\{s\le 0:Q(s)=0\}$$
denote the length of the ongoing busy period at time $0$ in the stationary regime.

Determine the exact asymptotics, as $t\to\infty$, of each of the three quantities $D_1(t)$, $D_2(t)$, and $\mathbb{P}(K>t)$; that is, find explicit functions $f_1,f_2,f_3$ such that $D_1(t)\sim f_1(t)$, $D_2(t)\sim f_2(t)$, and $\mathbb{P}(K>t)\sim f_3(t)$ as $t\to\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: For fractional Brownian motion input, logarithmic asymptotics of $D_1, D_2$ and of the busy-period tail $\mathbb{P}(K>t)$ are known (e.g., decay of order $\exp(-\vartheta t^{2-2H})$), and recent work on generalized fBm-driven queues sharpens large-deviation bounds. However, exact (sharp) asymptotics with explicit prefactors for general Gaussian input remain not fully established; the problem appears to be partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: On convergence to stationarity of fractional Brownian storage
status_evidence.snippet: decay rate roughly exp(-ϑ t^{2-2H}), with ϑ corresponding to the busy-period tail in fBm queue
status_evidence.claim: Logarithmic asymptotics of relaxation metrics tied to busy-period tail are known for fBm input.

status_evidence.title: Large deviations and long-time behavior of stochastic fluid queues with generalized fractional Brownian motion input
status_evidence.snippet: derives tail asymptotics using large deviation principles for generalized fBm input
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides large-deviation (logarithmic) asymptotics, not necessarily exact prefactors.
